ctx.x: union; can I pay these people more?" Then I stayed there with Billy Taylor, John Collins, Lloyd Troutman. They built the Embers because of Billy but they kept Billy at the Down Beat, sent Billy over there with streamers on... break

Just take a break and relax for a bit. Hey, Jo, I'm going to play some Teddy Wilson, Jo Jones, and Milt Hinton. Can't remember what year we did this in but we were doing a television show at CBS called "On a Saturday Afternoon", called the Teddy Wilson Hour and then we made an album with it for Norman Granz. Let's listen to some of that.
